name: Irina Spessivtseva
original_name: イリーナ・ スペシフツェワ
source:
A female operative specializing in assassination, she is a key member of PHOENIX. 

Born in a country where wars were rampant, she shoulders a heavy past. 

She values efficiency and can stay cool under pressure. 
While she is highly skilled at completing her missions, she has difficulty understanding human emotions.

Part of the PHOENIX mafia
